newsitem.title: USA: Domenici says still hoping for U.S. budget pact.
newsitem.headline: Domenici says still hoping for U.S. budget pact.

text.p: Senate Budget Committee Chairman Pete Domenici said Wednesday he is still hoping a budget agreement will be reached.

"I'm still hoping that we're going to get a comprehensive agreement, working toward that end, it's very difficult no doubt about it, but I would be doing something else, moving in another direction, if I didn't think this was the way to go and that had a chance," the New Mexico Republican told reporters.
Domenici said a lot of items had been put on the table in recent days and that staff-level discussions had taken place with regard to them.
He did not give specifics on what those items were.
"We are still moving ahead as rapidly as we can, this has reached a different stage," he said.
